Theorem
[Moser--Trudinger estimate] 1. ch7:7.15\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0174 If $u\in W_0^{1,n}(\Omega )$, there are $c_1,c_2>0$, depending only on $n$, such that \begin{equation} \tag {7.38} \int _\Omega \exp \! \left[\left(\frac{|u|}{c_1\| Du\| _n}\right)^{n/(n-1)}\right]dx \leq c_2|\Omega |. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Combine the pointwise estimate (7.37) with Lemma 7.13 for $p=n$.

□
